narrative:
Lake County has 162,435 registered voters, with 19.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 23.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 48.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 25.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.9% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +2.4% D−R vs -6.2% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
